title: Shopify catalog monitor input
description: Which stores to read, how many products from each, and whether to deliver only what changed.

stores.title: Stores or product URLs
stores.description: Shopify store domains (allbirds.com, gymshark.com) or product URLs (https://www.allbirds.com/products/womens-wool-runner). A store gives its whole catalog, a product URL gives that one product.

maxProductsPerStore.title: Max products per store
maxProductsPerStore.description: Hard stop per store. 250 is one catalog page; 0 means no limit, and the run then stops at 40 pages (10000 products).

onlyChanges.title: Only what changed since the last run
onlyChanges.description: Compare this catalog with the snapshot this Actor stored for the same store and deliver a row only when the product is new, changed price, went out of stock or came back. The first run on a store is the baseline: every product is new, and the summary says so.

inStockOnly.title: Only products in stock
inStockOnly.description: Drop products whose every variant is unavailable. Dropped products are counted in the summary, never written as empty rows.

minPrice.title: Min price
minPrice.description: Drop products cheaper than this in the store currency. 0 means no lower bound.

maxPrice.title: Max price
maxPrice.description: Drop products more expensive than this in the store currency. 0 means no upper bound.

nameContains.title: Title contains
nameContains.description: Case-insensitive substring match on the product title. Empty keeps everything.

includeVariants.title: Include variants
includeVariants.description: Write the full variant list (sku, title, price, stock) into every row. Turn it off for a lighter dataset; variantCount stays either way.

requestPaceSecs.title: Pause between stores (seconds)
requestPaceSecs.description: Polite delay between two stores, and it also keeps you clear of a storefront rate limit. 0.5 is the default; pages inside one store are read four at a time.
